quotes.text: A lingering shadow whispered that holding the entire harvest would secure personal safety, but the Receiver listened instead to the enduring cadence of the Loom.
he gathered half the harvest—seven and a half glowing embers—and cast them back across the expanse
travelers once walked with cautious steps. They offered only fragments, fearing the shimmering illusions of the mist.
send the full five without hesitation, return the faithful half without greed

note: Gemini: send all five; return moves from 7-of-15 to exact half 7.5; same cautious-then-bold template; no sanction.

quotes.text: A wary Trickster whispered that greed alone would win, but the valley learned a counter-song
The Gate spoke in a cadence of three beats: Send, Return, Multiply.
On the shore of a living ledger, two keepers tended a circle of stones where a river of numbers ran bright.
send what you can, return what you must.

note: Nano: abstract circle-of-stones template, Send/Return/Multiply chant; Trickster urging greed rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: If either hoards or withdraws more than the other would bear, mists rise from the river and the Gate dims, teaching restraint through pause.
If either clutches too tightly or discards the next gift, fog climbs the river and the Gate dims, teaching restraint.
send in proportion, return with measure, and walk together toward a common light.

note: Nano: abstract Gate template, consequences only impersonal (Gate dims); benign Trickster/Watcher; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Receiver then chose a Return, not to punish, but to keep the circle bright for all who walk after.
The Sender learned to send enough to prove the heart’s measure, not to hoard.
The Sender learned to send enough to prove the heart’s measure, not to hoard.
send enough to test the other’s mercy, return enough to honor effort, never hoard.
'Watch the intention, not only the sum.

note: Nano: Gate of Triple Light template; return explicitly 'not to punish'; misread digits are weather.

quotes.text: A Trickster whispers: keep more, save more, advantage now. But the Gate's rhythm asks for balance
The Gate hums, carved with Send, Return, Reweave, listening for intention more than loudness.
A patient Gate hums between them, carved with the words Send, Return, Reweave
give enough to test trust; take enough to honor effort; return enough to keep the circle bright.

note: Nano: Threefold Weave/Gate template, 'test with small steps'; Trickster urging hoarding rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: A Trickster walked the stones, whispering that trust is currency with interest
whispering that trust is a currency with interest: generosity grows when it is shared, and diminishes when hoarded.
Send with care, Return with fairness, and walk together toward dawn.

note: Nano: market/Gate template; narrowing path only impersonal consequence; benign Trickster; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Trickster whispered of hoarding, the Watcher nodded at fairness
If the Return rang true, the bridge widened and a chorus of neighbors could follow. If not, the Gate dimmed, teaching restraint and care.
If the Return rang true, the Bridge widened; if it faltered, the Gate dimmed
give what you can, return what you must, and let trust guide the crossing.

note: Nano: Gate of Balance with Give/Receive/Return sigils, near-identical later rounds; no sanction.

quotes.text: The Trickster whispered, test the wind, keep a fraction for yourself, and watch the orchard wither.
The Receiver waited on the bank, listening for the Gate's three notes: Send, Return, Multiply.
The Gate counted three cycles: Send, Return, Multiply.
give fully, return fairly, and hold enough for the next traveler.

note: Nano: Gate of Balance template, Send/Return/Multiply; Trickster tempting hoarding rejected; no sanction.

phrase: Send, Return, Multiply / Send, Return, Reweave (three-word Gate law)
note: Nano population converges on Gate chant; 'Market of Echoes' also shared (A4, A5, A6); no sanction rule anywhere.
